retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast group portrait centered in a dark void, illuminated by a soft blue overhead spotlight with minimalist geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central cluster of figures is isolated in a deep black environment, lit from above by a diffused blue circular glow that creates a heavy vignette. The composition is anchored by a centered line of lowercase geometric text positioned in the upper third of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject cluster centered horizontally and vertically
Blue-to-black radial gradient defining the upper half
High-contrast lighting on subjects against absolute black
Typography aligned to the horizontal center of the spotlight
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space occupying at least 60% of the frame
Soft-edged blue radial gradient in the top half

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Small central cluster of figures, occupying approximately 20% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright blue spotlight in the upper half acts as the primary anchor for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the blue glow, reads the centered text, then drops to the high-contrast figures in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subjects on three sides.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation blue fading into zero-value black; high-value white highlights on subjects.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Forward slash used as a separator between phrases
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single weight geometric sans used for all elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the circular counters and geometric 1960s feel.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and lowercase aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a photograph of a group of people in 1960s attire, centered in a pitch-black studio. Light them with a single soft blue spotlight from above that creates a diffused circular glow in the upper half of the frame, leaving the bottom half in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of lowercase geometric sans-serif text in white, centered horizontally within the blue spotlight area.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure black at the edges?
Is the blue light a soft radial gradient?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the central cluster
mustRedesign: Hard edges on the spotlight gradient

avoid: Color bleeding outside the blue/white/black palette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no logos or specific brand marks are present.
Verify the 'o' characters are perfectly circular.
Check that the subjects are high-contrast against the black floor.
Confirm the blue glow does not reach the bottom corners.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered group + Top-down blue radial glow + Lowercase geometric sans-serif = Atmospheric 60s Noir.
